Article 2 (Timing of Prior Announcement of Legislation)
The chairperson of a committee shall, immediately after consulting with the executive secretaries, make a prior announcement of legislation pursuant to the main sentence of Article 82-2 (1) of the National Assembly Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") in respect of bills referred to that committee (excluding bills referred to the Legislation and Judiciary Committee for examination of the legislative system and wording): Provided, That where the chairperson deems it necessary, the chairperson may determine a different time in consultation with the executive secretaries.
